summary: Frontend-only fidelity + navigation testing of the redesigned Company Home (Accueil) page. All 10 requested checks pass on the live preview URL. Layout matches the final left-aligned mockup with the 124px logo tile, dominant user name, green status pill (CheckCircle2), watermark at ~5% opacity on a light-grey body background. No 'Point d'entrée du mandat' text anywhere on the page or sidebar. Sidebar item Accueil (nav-company_home) is present, active on the Home page, and correctly returns from module views. Deterministic landing works: persona_finance (mono) → /company/<id>/home directly; admin (multi) → Tous les mandats then Accéder → company-home with correct name. Module click opens a flyout popover (flyout-ACCOUNTING), not an accordion. Mandate switcher updates the active mandate and reloads the correct home. Refresh on the /home URL stays deterministic (no rebound to a module). No JS console errors related to Home; one unrelated 404 on a non-critical resource.
verified_ok: Mono-mandat landing: persona_finance@accslegro.com → https://.../company/965f0770-.../home directly, company-home rendered (no bounce to Comptabilité).

Header: 'Bonjour' visible, company-home-user='Persona E — Responsable financier' (dominant text-5xl), company-home-name='meelora' with green company-home-status-active (CheckCircle2), company-home-address='25 avenue Dumas, Genève, Genève, 1206, CH'.
No 'Point d'entrée du mandat' text on the page (count=0) and none in the sidebar (aside filter count=0).
No capsule/pill wrapper around identity: company block class = 'mt-2 flex items-center gap-2' (no rounded/bg-* pill).
Watermark: company-home-watermark present with computed opacity 0.05; body background stays rgb(243,244,246) — light, not dark blue.
Sidebar Accueil: [data-testid=nav-company_home] present, visible, active on Home; module ACCOUNTING opens flyout-ACCOUNTING as popover (verified visible after click).
Return path: click a submodule (Aperçu) → leaves company-home, then click nav-company_home → company-home re-mounts.
KPIs: 5 KPI cards render (kpi-acc.revenue_month, revenue_ytd, open_invoices, collections_month, active_customers) with proper Ventes numbers (CHF), no empty cards; company-home-kpi-hint visible.

Quick actions (company-home-quick-actions with 4 buttons: Nouvelle facture, Paiements reçus, Clients, Rapports), Activités récentes (company-home-recent, 6+ entries) and À savoir panel (company-home-info, 3 entries) all present and populated.
Refresh determinism: reload on /company/<id>/home stays on the same URL and re-renders company-home (no redirect to a module).

Multi-mandat admin@accslegro.com: lands on 'Tous les mandats' (text count=2, company-home count=0). Clicking Accéder navigates to /company/58a59a28-.../home with company-home-name='9434-3977 QC inc.'.

Mandat switcher: [data-testid=mandat-switcher] opens list of mandat-switch-<id> options; selecting a different one navigates to that company's /home and updates company-home-name (validated: switched to 'TEST NoLogo 1196753', URL changed, home re-mounted, no cross-company leak observed).
critical_code_review_comments: CompanyHome.js: consider capping visible mandat-switch options or filtering out demo/QA sandbox companies (currently 4 entries incl. 'TEST NoLogo …' surface for admin) — not a bug but noisy UX.
test_credentials: persona_finance@accslegro.com / persona123 (mono-mandat, meelora), admin@accslegro.com / admin123 (multi-mandat). Both valid on preview URL.

No pending frontend or backend issues from this pass. If next iteration touches the KPI registry or the /home aggregator, revalidate KPI codes and destinations against Layout.js route table.
